Fractional CTO / Technical Advisor

Company: Novatech (seed-stage, AI product, 12 people)

We are looking for a fractional technical leader for 6 months.

Mandate
- Technical roadmap: architecture review, AI/ML strategy for our product
- Hiring: tech stack decisions, interview loop for 2 senior engineers
- Governance: code quality bar, delivery process, security basics

Profile: hands-on CTO/Staff background; you must still be able to write code weekly

Format: advisory contract (B2B), 10-20 h/week
Fee: $3,000 - $4,000 per month
Remote: async-first, weekly sync 10:00 UTC
No exclusivity; you may hold multiple advisory roles
Application: reply to this letter (coo@novatech.example)

notes: E archetype positive; principal-level posting (overqualification module gap=0).
